signature.one_line: Music-led BTS event montage, flash transitions, no overlays until an outlined brand + contact card.
unique_devices: Zero text overlays for ~95 % of runtime: the brand reads only through in-shot uniforms, signage and branded props
Light-flash / white-out soft changes between locations (62 % of cuts soft, one full white-out at ~24 %)
End card only on the last ~38 frames, hard-cut onto the final high wide: accent brand line with white outline over a 1.2x larger black contact number with white outline at 28-32 % H
Calm walk-to-camera opener (~13 % of runtime) then two bursts of ~15-frame shots at 48-60 cuts/min
signature.why_it_works: Scale and energy of a real event do the selling; constant motion and music hits hold attention; the only text is the one thing the viewer must act on.

hook.type: in medias res (walk-to-camera through a busy set)
hook.first_frame: A crew lead with a headset mic walks toward camera through a lit, crowded event set; uniformed team and lit props behind; coloured stage light shifting

structure.what: Crew lead walks to camera through the set, music hook lands on frame 0
Crew prepping, white-out flash, props raised, a costumed performer as a pattern interrupt
DJ/host on mic, branded stage vehicles, performers in line; scale of the operation
Coordinators directing with headsets, the happy client, family placards, crowd from above
High wide of the whole procession with the two-line brand + contact end card

broll_inserts.what: 100 % B-roll montage of the crew and event
broll_inserts.how: ~55 % medium handheld shots of crew/people, ~35 % wides of set and vehicles, ~10 % close shots of the client; every shot shows branded uniforms or signage

camera.how: Handheld, subject walks in from mid-ground to medium shot
All motion from the phone operator; one high-angle wide for the payoff and the end card

transitions.how: ~6-frame flash to white between setup shots
Shots of ~15 frames (48-60 cuts/min) on music hits

end_card.how: Hard cut in on the same frame as the last shot, static, held to the final frame, over the dark/sky part of a high wide; line 1 brand name centre 28.5 % H, line 2 contact number centre 31.8 % H, both white-outlined, no box

other_text_spec.when: last ~5 % of runtime (final shot only, ~38 frames)
other_text_spec.copy: brand name, sentence case, ~14 characters (placeholder 'Brand name here')
other_text_spec.font_class: geometric/neo-grotesque sans, semibold-bold, double-storey a, round o (social-app 'classic' text look)

measured.note: 10 digits; fill estimated = outline bbox (3.67 % H / 37.6 % W) minus the stroke

other_text_spec.note: the number is set ~1.2x larger than the brand line

other_text_spec.entry: hard cut in on the same frame as the last shot, no fade/pop

style.look_intent: mid-contrast, saturated, neutral-warm night event footage: magenta/red uniforms, purple-blue stage light, warm gold practicals; phone-native

sound.music: music with vocals throughout (party rap/pop; measured speech_coverage 0.74 is the sung vocal), beat periodicity 0.74, ~64 bpm estimate (half-time); no voiceover, no ducking
sfx: none; the 5 hard cuts are not on detected onsets (measured cut_hit_share 0.0) - cuts follow the music phrases, not lyrics
optional: light whoosh/flash hit on the white-out

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.role: two fast-cut bursts on music hits

use_when: the user has lots of raw phone clips from an event, shoot or job and wants a sizzle/BTS reel
branding is visible in the footage itself (uniforms, signage, vehicles, props)
the goal is bookings/enquiries with one contact line at the end
there is no speech, or only music
avoid_when: the message needs explanation, steps or claims in words
the footage carries no visible branding (add a persistent logo bug instead)
only a licensed commercial song is available and the platform will mute it
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B37 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B37.json) to this brand.
This blueprint has NO captions and NO overlays until the end card: a music-led phone BTS montage. Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{ACCENT}} and {{ACCENT_2}} fills sit inside a {{TEXT}} outline, and the outlined lines must stay >= 3:1 against the dark/sky area of the last shot)
- {{TEXT}}: outline colour of both end-card lines, default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}: brand-name fill, default #E31E28
- {{ACCENT_2}}: contact-line fill, default #000000
- {{SURFACE}}: unused, default none
- {{CARD_BG}}: unused, default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: default Poppins 600
- {{FONT_BODY}}: default Poppins 600
- {{HANDLE}}: contact line (phone number or "@handle")
- {{LOGO}}: not overlaid; the brand must be visible in-shot (uniforms, signage, props)

EDIT
1. Open with a walk-to-camera of the lead person through the busiest part of the set (~13 % of runtime), music hitting on frame 0.
2. Then cut every ~42 frames (median shot 1.42), with two bursts of ~15-frame shots (48-60 cuts/min) at ~20-40 % and ~60-80 % of runtime on the music's hits; cut on musical phrases, not on lyrics.
3. ~62 % of changes soft: ~6-frame light-flash/flare or quick blend between locations; one ~6-frame white-out early (~24 %). No punch-ins; all motion handheld.
4. Order: walk-in -> prep / pattern interrupt -> scale proof (vehicles, stage, performers) -> people directing + happy client -> high wide.

CAPTIONS
5. None; do not caption song lyrics. No logo bug; let in-shot branding carry the brand 5+ times.

OTHER TEXT (end card, last shot only, ~38 frames)
6. Hard-cut in on the same frame as the final high wide, static, held to the last frame, over a dark/sky area.
7. Line 1, brand name, sentence case: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 61 px, fill {{ACCENT}}, {{TEXT}} outline ~4 px, no shadow/box; centred, centre y 28.5 % H (x 25.8-72.6 % at ~14 characters, ink 2.97 % H).
8. Line 2, {{HANDLE}} / phone digits: {{FONT_BODY}} 73 px (~1.2x line 1), fill {{ACCENT_2}}, {{TEXT}} outline ~4 px; centred directly under line 1, centre y 31.8 % H (outline box 30.0-33.6 % H, ~37.6 % W for 10 digits).

SOUND: music with vocals at full level, no voiceover. Normalise to -14 LUFS and limit true peak to -1 dBTP (do not clip).
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: mid-contrast, saturated, neutral-warm night event colour (rich uniforms, purple-blue stage light, warm practicals).

VERIFY before rendering: render a test end-card frame with "Brand name here" (or the real brand) and a 10-digit number, then measure:
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_endcard> --box 0.22,0.255,0.78,0.30 --ink "#E31E28:80"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at <t_endcard> --box 0.25,0.30,0.75,0.34 --ink "#FFFFFF:40"
Swap the --ink colours to {{ACCENT}} / {{TEXT}}. Compute the expected ink height/width of the brand's actual line with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py at 61 px / 73 px; a 14-character line in Poppins 600 61 px should read ~2.97-3.2 % H; the 10-digit outline box ~3.67 % H / 37.6 % W. Positions within +-1 % of frame height.
